guidebook.intro: Mpira, muziki na michezo. Jifunze kusema unachopenda kufanya kwa Kiingereza.

tips.title: I like + -ing
body: **Ku-** ya Kiswahili mara nyingi ni **to**: **kuimba → to sing**. Baada ya **like**, Kiingereza hupendelea **-ing**: **I like singing** (ninapenda kuimba).
Vivyo hivyo: **I love dancing**, **She enjoys swimming**. Baada ya **want**, tumia **to**: **I want to swim.**

tips.title: Play au dance?
body: **Kucheza** ina maneno mawili kwa Kiingereza: **play** kwa michezo (**play football**, **play cards**) na **dance** kwa densi.
Muziki: **play the drums** (piga ngoma), **sing a song** (imba wimbo), **listen to music** (sikiliza muziki).

culture.title: Premier League
body: Mashabiki wengi Afrika Mashariki hufuatilia **Premier League** ya Uingereza. Utasikia **What’s the score?** (matokeo ni ngapi?) na **It’s a draw** (sare).
